question: Should Discord role mentions wake agents via an explicit opt-in trigger-role config, automatic bot role membership, or the broader Discord access-control redesign?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds a new Discord config surface and determines how multi-agent fan-out behaves when a shared role is mentioned.

options.title: Use explicit trigger role IDs
options.body: Add a narrow guild/channel trigger-role list and treat only configured mentioned roles as wake signals while keeping sender roles as access control.

options.title: Fold into access-control redesign
options.body: Defer this issue to the broader bypass/mention/deny Discord access model so sender authorization and role-trigger semantics are decided together.

options.title: Decline role fan-out
options.body: Keep direct mentions and @everyone/@here as the only wake signals and document role mentions as non-triggering metadata.

recommendation.title: Use explicit trigger role IDs
recommendation.body: Add a narrow guild/channel trigger-role list and treat only configured mentioned roles as wake signals while keeping sender roles as access control.
